caption:
Busy? Please. You're hiding from a feeling. Four translations.
Name it first: bored, stupid, scared, judged. Then two minutes of the ugly part.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#procrastination #productivity #selfawareness

alt.1: Cella under a spotlight next to a big orange page. Save · 4 translations. Busy? Please. You're hiding from a feeling. 4 translations of procrastination.
alt.2: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “I'll do it tomorrow.” What it means: Today it makes me feel bad. Tomorrow-me can feel it.
alt.3: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “I work better under pressure.” What it means: Panic is the only boss I listen to.
alt.4: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “I just need to clean first.” What it means: The kitchen is easier than the email.
alt.5: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “I'll start when I feel like it.” What it means: Feeling like it rarely comes first.
alt.6: four steps as a list. The cheat sheet. When you put it off, ask: Save it. Read it before the next “tomorrow.” 1. What will this make me feel? 2. Name it: bored, stupid, scared, judged 3. Do two minutes of the ugly part 4. Then decide again.
